name: Mercedes-Benz SS Erdmann & Rossi 1930
description:
Mercedes-Benz SS (W 06) Sport Roadster, coachwork by Erdmann & Rossi, Berlin-Halensee - after chassis 36348, built in 1930 as a two-seat works racer, rebodied by Erdmann & Rossi in 1934 and Best of Show at Pebble Beach in 2001. M 06 7.1 litre SOHC six with the Roots blower: 170 PS, 225 PS with the blower engaged by flooring the throttle; 4-speed (2.75/1.55/1.12/1.00) on a 2.48 axle; beam axle and live axle on semi-elliptic leaves; mechanical drum brakes; 6.50-20 tyres on wire wheels; 3,400 mm wheelbase; about 1,850 kg. Right-hand drive.

3D model: "Mercedes Benz SS Roadster | www.vecarz.com" by vecarz, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/mercedes-benz-ss-roadster-wwwvecarzcom-9ab3f68bd7db462b918faa8ecd5c0d15
This mod is shared under the same licence (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): non-commercial, credit the authors.
Port, physics, gauges, skins: Street Corsa Mods - https://streetcorsamods.com/
Driver pose and animations: Kunos Simulazioni.
